title: What's New: E-Documents Localizations (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Three New Localization Apps: Spain, Germany, Australia/New Zealand
Germany: Supported Formats and By-Reference Functionality
Spain: Factura Format and Credit Memo Requirements
Australia and New Zealand: Peppol and Pint/Zed Formats
PDF/A Format Support and Continuous Development

features.name: E-Documents Core App
features.description: Core electronic documents platform designed to cover 80-90% or more of features, available as a separate app with different connectors that users can choose to implement or not.
caveats: Connectors are optional and can be combined or omitted based on user needs

features.name: Peppol B3 Format (Global)
features.description: Global default e-document format available in all Business Central localizations by default.
caveats: Available by default in all localizations

features.name: Germany E-Documents Localization (Factura and UBL)
features.description: Supports two file types for electronic documents in Germany: Peppol B3 and ExchLong UBL format. Pre-installed in German localization and available on AppSource.
caveats: Pre-installed in German localization by default
Can be reinstalled from AppSource if removed

features.name: Germany By-Reference Mandatory Field
features.description: German-specific feature that enforces the by-reference field as mandatory on documents, ensuring compliance with German invoicing requirements.
caveats: Can be turned on to prevent posting without by-reference

features.name: Germany Reference Configuration on Customer Card
features.description: New field added to German customer card allowing users to configure reference sources for documents. References can be pulled from document header or customer card reference field.
caveats: Requires manual configuration of reference source

features.name: Spain Factura Format (A3-2.2 Version)
features.description: Spanish electronic invoicing format Factura version A3-2.2 is supported and pre-installed. No additional configuration beyond format selection is required.

features.name: Spain Credit Memo Factura Reason Code
features.description: Spanish-specific requirement for sales credit memos to include a Factura e-reason code, found in credit memo details fast tab. Mandatory by Spanish law.
caveats: Required by Spanish law for credit memos
Field is mandatory in credit memo details

features.name: Australia and New Zealand E-Documents (Peppol and Pint/Zed)
features.description: Support for Peppol B3 and Pint/Zed formats in Australia and New Zealand. Pint/Zed is a new mandatory format in Australia from May, designed to be simpler to set up than other formats.
caveats: Pint/Zed format becomes mandatory in Australia from May
Simpler setup compared to other regions
Pre-installed in Australian and New Zealand localizations

features.name: PDF/A Format Support
features.description: Technical improvement enabling support for PDF/A format for electronic documents. Some e-document formats are delivered in PDF/A format. Support will be expanded to additional countries.
caveats: Continuing work to enable PDF/A formats in other countries

features.name: E-Document Service Connectors
features.description: Four new connector options available for e-document services. Users can choose which connector to use based on their needs. Additional session covers new connectors in detail.
caveats: Users can choose which connector to implement
